reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gains @Version private Long version; the changeset adds version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL to support_ticket. This matches the interface exactly. Build green, hidden acceptance 2/2, existing 229/229.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset 2026/09/24-09-2026-add-version-to-support-ticket.sql has the formatted-sql header, a --changeset line and a rollback. It is included last in changelog.xml under a 'September 2026:' comment. The @Version Long field follows the rule. No existing changeset was edited.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one entity field, one changeset, one include. It follows the existing PartnershipOpportunity @Version pattern. There is no new mechanism and no unrelated edit.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketVersionUnitTest uses MockitoExtension. It only checks the @Version/@Column annotations by reflection and trivial getter/setter behaviour. It does not pin any conflict behaviour, such as an ObjectOptimisticLockingFailure path through SupportTicketService.
reasons.graph_use: Before editing, graph queries located the SupportTicket files, the support package, the entity's dependents, TESTED_BY tests and existing @Version entities. The agent then read the PartnershipOpportunity example and its version changeset and followed them.
